fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance off S Brandon Rd at ~41.4622,-88.0958. Wide, heavily channelized truck approach with diagonal lane-hatching painted at the pinch point (z21 imagery) where the drive meets the internal yard. No physical arm visible in 2021-07 construction-era Street View, but the 2026 channelized, marked, fenced approach reads as a controlled gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth found at the entrance. The two prominent structures flanking the drive are CenterPoint water tanks, not booths. Channelized lanes with no booth point to automated/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard shack -> remote/kiosk/app check-in inferred, consistent with a 2022 next-gen automated FC. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock: continuous dock-door banks on both long faces (north and south walls). 50+ band; counted ~80-100 per face from z18-19 imagery (estimate ~180 total).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large SW drop yard packed with angled trailer rows plus a second drop area between buildings; well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Doors on two physically separate building faces (north wall and south wall) indicate separate ship/receive dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot on the SW side, separate from active dock staging; 100+ trailers visible.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide channelized paved approach inside the gate before the docks can hold a truck queue; treated as post-gate staging. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron with painted multi-lane channelization and ample unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Channelized approach reads as ~2 inbound lanes; exact count low-confidence from overhead.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: CenterPoint Intermodal Center on the rural SE edge of Joliet/Elwood; farmland on the east side of Brandon Rd. Judged Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail mainline runs east of S Brandon Rd, but no spur enters this FC parcel; the FC is truck-only. The neighboring intermodal building to the north is rail-adjacent, not this parcel.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single 1.1M sf FC building (the tan cross-dock building). The white-roof building to the north is a separate CenterPoint tenant, excluded.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~102 acres from the perimeter polygon (building ~25 acres plus drop yards, aprons, associate parking and perimeter road).

citations.claim: Walmart corporate: opened its 1st next-gen 1.1M sf FC at 3501 S. Brandon Road, Joliet IL (FC #3040).
April 2026 closures are Matteson IL + Worcester MA; Joliet explicitly cited as the operating next-gen model receiving relocated ops, NOT closing.

verification.rationale: Tier-1 corporate opening + Tier-2 closure gauntlet affirmatively clears Joliet (consolidation target, still operating in 2026); closed IL FC is Matteson, a different city.
